criteria.adopt_rule: A variant is an adoption candidate only if warm and end-to-end CI upper bounds are at most speed_win_ratio with accuracy_pass in at least 75% of planned representative_shape cells on EVERY platform in platforms_required. Incomplete, failed and unavailable cells cannot qualify. No default changes either way.

not_selected_controls.reason: supplement chunks both CPU and GPU by requested width

supported_variant: canonical f32 scorer loss path; independently seeded targets, same batch width on CPU/GPU
unsupported: alternate sparse layouts and bf16/f16 storage are not accepted by the scorer GPU API; v4 whole-scan control is not selected in this supplement

unsupported_combinations.reason: scorer GPU API accepts canonical f32 networks, not experimental layout or weight-storage types
